{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Exclude test orders and refunded orders
completed_orders = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Return the value for submission
print(total_revenue)"}
